records.source_scope: Study-specific NR vulcanizate with curatives; not raw SMR 10 or a no-additive pure polymer. The selected density uses three specimens, not the four crosslinking-density specimens. For the density result only, arithmetic aggregation and meaning of ± remain unspecified. Do not import E100–200 finite-strain slope as Young’s modulus. The additional E100–200 tensile slope uses five quasi-static specimens and mechanical mean ± SD only. This supplement adds source-labelled tensile stress at break as a separate quantity; property-specific statistics and unknown fracture criterion remain explicit. Two separate source-reported stress facts at explicit200% and400% strain targets are proposed;not modulus slopes or break stress.
